provenance.filters: Queried by UAE admin area, then filtered again by point-in-polygon against the ARE outline in gulf_boundaries.geojson. Generic-noun names and disused, abandoned and under-construction lifecycle tags dropped. No distance thinning: every site that passes is kept, because the model runs per site.
provenance.naming: English name from name:en, int_name or official_name:en where OSM carries one. Otherwise a deterministic transliteration of the Arabic name, with the original kept in nameLocal. nameSource records which route each name took.
provenance.nearestSource: great-circle km and coordinates of the nearest Ginoux 2012 MAM polygon vertex
provenance.caveat: Ginoux's grid is 0.1 deg, about 11 km, while saltating sand lands within tens of metres. nearestSourceKm is REGIONAL CONTEXT for the suspension and drift pathways only. It is not the source of saltating sand at the asset. See DUST_EXPOSURE_MODULE_SPEC.md section 2.
